description: The OTTO Content Engine — a complete creative playbook for producing viral short-form video campaigns using found movie clips (playphrase.me), AI-generated B-roll (Gemini VideoFX), and iMovie-ready edit lists. Use this skill whenever a user wants to make a product launch video, social campaign, viral ad, or brand awareness content using pop-culture clips. Also trigger for: "make a video campaign", "viral launch content", "we need something for social", "help me make a video for [product]", "I want to do a Bumblebee-style video", "movie clip mashup for my brand", "content engine". This skill runs the full creative process: discovery interview → PI persona selection → clip sourcing → creative brief → shot-by-shot edit list → Gemini B-roll prompts → iMovie assembly guide. It is intentionally collaborative — the user drives creative decisions, the skill provides the structure and handles the heavy lifting.
